title: Prom Night
blurb: A 1980 slasher, a ghost story that took its name, that ghost story's own sequel, an unrelated fourth film and a 2008 remake.

groups.title: The Mary Lou films
groups.note: Linked to the first film only by the school.

note: Hello Mary Lou was written as a standalone film and renamed. Its only link to the first film is the school. The Last Kiss continues the Mary Lou story, Deliver Us from Evil is unrelated, and the 2008 film remakes the original.
